GenericTalentStormShield.name: Storm Shield
GenericTalentStormShield.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.name: Bolt of the Storm
GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

ETCMasteryGuitarHero.name: Guitar Hero
ETCMasteryGuitarHero.description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

ETCMasteryProgRock.name: Prog Rock
ETCMasteryProgRock.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100 Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 Health every second while it is active.

ETCBlockParty.name: Block Party
ETCBlockParty.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

ETCCrowdSurfer.name: Crowd Surfer
ETCCrowdSurfer.description: Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 6 seconds and refund the Mana cost.

L90ETCMasteryFaceMeltLoudSpeakers.name: Loud Speakers
L90ETCMasteryFaceMeltLoudSpeakers.description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

ETCMasterySpeedMetal.name: Speed Metal
ETCMasterySpeedMetal.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

L90ETCMasteryFaceMeltPinballWizard.name: Pinball Wizard
L90ETCMasteryFaceMeltPinballWizard.description: Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.

ETCMasteryHammeron.name: Hammer-on
ETCMasteryHammeron.description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks deal 12% more damage, increased to 36% while Guitar Solo is active.

ETCCombatStyleEchoPedal.name: Echo Pedal
ETCCombatStyleEchoPedal.description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

ETCHeroicAbilityMoshPit.name: Mosh Pit
ETCHeroicAbilityMoshPit.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

ETCHeroicAbilityStageDive.name: Stage Dive
ETCHeroicAbilityStageDive.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

ETCMasteryMicCheck.name: Mic Check
ETCMasteryMicCheck.description: Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.

ETCMasteryEncore.name: Encore
ETCMasteryEncore.description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later. Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

ETCMasteryFaceSmelt.name: Face Smelt
ETCMasteryFaceSmelt.description: Face Melt Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.

ETCMasteryShowStopper.name: Show Stopper
ETCMasteryShowStopper.description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

ETCMasteryGuitarSoloAggressiveShredding.name: Aggressive Shredding
ETCMasteryGuitarSoloAggressiveShredding.description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.

GenericTalentImposingPresence.name: Imposing Presence
GenericTalentImposingPresence.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds. Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

L90ETCMasteryMoshPitTourBus.name: Tour Bus
L90ETCMasteryMoshPitTourBus.description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

L90ETCMasteryStageDiveCrowdPleaser.name: Crowd Pleaser
L90ETCMasteryStageDiveCrowdPleaser.description: Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.

L90ETCMasteryDeathMetal.name: Death Metal
L90ETCMasteryDeathMetal.description: Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.

L90ETCPoweroftheHorde.name: Power of the Horde
L90ETCPoweroftheHorde.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds, increased by 2% for each other allied Hero in the area.

L90ETCRidetheLightning.name: Ride the Lightning
L90ETCRidetheLightning.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location and deal 48 damage to nearby enemy Heroes. The cooldown is reduced by 10 second for every enemy Hero hit, up to 50 seconds.
